bib.title: CogView: Mastering Text-to-Image Generation via Transformers
bib.venue: NeurIPS 2021 (35th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems)

question: Can a single large autoregressive Transformer over text tokens and VQ-VAE image tokens do general-domain text-to-image generation, and how can its fp16 training be stabilised?
hypothesis: Joint large-scale generative pretraining on text and discrete image tokens (as in GPT) gives strong text-to-image generation; numerical instability from data heterogeneity can be cured by regularising values (PB-relax, Sandwich-LN).
contributions: Open-source 4B text-to-image transformer beating DALL-E and GANs on blurred-COCO FID
Finetuning for super-resolution, captioning/self-reranking, style learning, fashion design
Caption Loss metric and self-reranking replacing CLIP
PB-relax and Sandwich-LN to stabilise training

method.summary: Two stages: a discrete autoencoder image tokenizer (256x256 -> 32x32 tokens, codebook 8192) and a 48-layer GPT trained left-to-right on concatenated [text; image] tokens from 30M Chinese-centric pairs. Finetuned variants do super-resolution, captioning (for CapLoss reranking), style learning and fashion.
method.task: text-to-image generation (autoregressive joint text+image token language modelling)

datasets.name: CogView pretraining set (WudaoCorpora extension)
datasets.size: about 30 million text-image pairs; 2.5TB raw, about 250GB tokenized
datasets.source: professional image sites, Conceptual Captions, ImageNet, news, Alibaba item-caption pairs, search engines (1,200 entity queries, top-100 images each); about 50% of text English, machine-translated to Chinese
datasets.preprocessing: watermarks and white edges not removed

datasets.name: Super-resolution finetune set
datasets.preprocessing: crop to 256x256, downsample to 128x128, tokenize to 16x16 / 32x32 pairs

datasets.name: Style finetune sets
datasets.source: Google, Baidu, Bing search with keyword 'An image of {style} style'

datasets.name: MS COCO
datasets.size: 30,000 captions subset; 5,000 images for CapLoss; 50 captions for human eval
datasets.preprocessing: captions machine-translated to Chinese; Gaussian blur at FID-0 to FID-8 on real and generated images

other.image_tokenizer: 4-layer CNN encoder, 512 hidden, three stride-2 receptive-field-4 convs then 1x1 to 256; decoder mirrors with deconvs; Xavier uniform init; |V|=8192, d=256

other.note: only said stabilised by PB-relax and Sandwich-LN
numbers extracted from its figures; not open-source

training.objective: next-token cross-entropy on text and image tokens with equal weight (NLL of text + NLL of z); stage 1 reconstruction (L2) for tokenizer
training.tokens: inferred: 96B (6.7M x 144,000; paper states 96B trained tokens)
training.precision: almost FP16 (O2: forward/backward FP16, optimizer states and master weights FP32)
training.regularisation: beta1 0.9, beta2 0.95; embedding gradient shrink alpha=0.1; PB-relax; Sandwich-LN

other.finetuning_cost: all finetuning tasks within one day on a single DGX-2

inference.decoding: autoregressive token-by-token; best of N by CapLoss
inference.samples: 60 generated images per caption, lowest CapLoss selected (DALL-E uses 512 + CLIP)
inference.prompting: Chinese caption; for style: 'A {object} of {style} style'

parameters.super_resolution: 16x16 -> 32x32 tokens finetune, then 32x32 -> 64x64 (512x512 px) via center-continuous sliding window

metrics.name: FID-k
metrics.definition: Frechet Inception Distance after Gaussian blur radius k on real and generated images

metrics.name: CapLoss
metrics.definition: mean cross-entropy of caption tokens given image

metrics.name: Human evaluation
metrics.definition: 1-5 scores for clarity, texture, relevance; 1-10 overall; pick best of 5

eval.protocol: 30,000 COCO captions for FID; human eval: 50 captions, 72 evaluators invited, 59 kept (filter: completed all, over 80% best picks match top overall score), 150 yuan each, 2,950 comparison groups; A-B test for super-resolution. No seeds or significance tests.

limits: Slow token-by-token generation and VQ-VAE blurriness (authors)
DALL-E comparison uses numbers read from DALL-E figures; DALL-E not open-source so reasons for the FID gap are guesses
FID-0 not better than DM-GAN/DF-GAN (26.5); best results are on blurred FID
Human eval small: 50 captions, no DALL-E in it
No full-scale ablation of PB-relax/Sandwich-LN; evidence is a toy setup and a 500M run
Authors say the text-loss-weight finding comes from small-scale experiments without numbers
Sparse attention not used in the 4B model
Potential misuse/deepfake and gender bias acknowledged

terms.definition: Precision Bottleneck Relaxation: divide by the max before LayerNorm and compute attention as Q^T(K/(alpha sqrt d)) with max subtraction to avoid overflow
adds a LayerNorm at the end of each residual branch
